static_traits.name: Li Jing
static_traits.social_status: 与骑行伙伴的关系受影响，因经常与他人比较而感到自卑；有几位朋友可交谈，但尚not yet向他们提及Self-doubt问题。
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾接受心理治疗或咨询；No major physical illness。
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude；能清晰描述训练场景中的自动化思维与情绪体验；愿意探索替代性观点。

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信自己永远not会在骑行项目中获得参赛资格，这种信念导致了not足感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: The key factor that made me decide to seek counseling is realizing that these negative beliefs are affecting my motivation and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: 几个月前not yet能达成一个个人骑行目标后，Self-doubt和not足感显著加重；当时因给自己施加很大压力以在骑行比赛中取得成功，最初的应激水平很高。
以往在竞争性情境中经常出现类似的Self-doubt和not足感；此前not yet接受过心理方面的治疗或咨询；without显著身体疾病史。

special_situations.event: In training, sees a group of riders speed past her, others performing better than her
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人比我骑得好，就说明I am not good enough/not配参加比赛
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies training, sets stricter goals in an attempt to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我Why keep trying?我not如他们，我永远也拿not到参赛资格

special_situations.event: 每次开始训练前就涌现强烈Anxiety，预感将再次失败
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能保证成功，那训练就have not意义；一次失败意味着我会一直失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在训练中not断自我施压，试图用更严格的目标Undoing失败感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will fail again，have not意义，我注定not行

special_situations.event: 几个月前not yet达成个人骑行目标之后对自我能力的Overall evaluation全面下滑
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail at one important goal, it means I am a failure overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: With harsher self-demands and training intensity, compensates for the fear of being defined as a loser
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure，什么都做not好

special_situations.event: 想到要向骑行朋友谈及Self-doubt时，担心被评判为软弱或not够能力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我暴露脆弱感，他们就会看not起我/认为我not够能干
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持Silence、not向朋友倾诉，以避免他人评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很弱、能力not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and worthy of respect, and to be seen making progress and having value in cycling
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为without能、被比较后显得not如人，进而被轻视或疏远
defense_goal: Maintains a controllable self-image through self-blame and stricter goals
Keeps silent, avoids exposing vulnerability to evade others' judgment

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、易被定义为失败者的人
object_relations.object_representation: Others / peers who are more outstanding and may judge her

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores sharing feelings with friends or suggests seeking peer support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为朋友会像竞争者一样评判自己为软弱、not够能力（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹豫和防御的语气表达担心被看not起，避免深入具体细节，语句中多use“他们会觉得…”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out their generalizing a single failure into an overall failure, and inquires into the function of the training strategy
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者把过度训练Interpretation为“对自己负责”的必要之举，以抵御被视为失败者的Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use理性Interpretation和“应该/必须”措辞说明为何需要更严格目标，语气坚定但回避情绪层面的探讨。

manifestations: 在开始训练前感到“已被打败”，认为训练have not意义
A single failure is experienced as an overall failure, thereby weakening the enjoyment of leisure in life
outcomes: Difficulty relaxing on weekends, interests impaired

manifestations: 担心被朋友评判为软弱而not敢分享内心困扰
Relationship with cycling partners damaged by comparison
outcomes: Decreased quality of interaction with others

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为同伴会看not起自己、把自I am not good enough的感受归因于他人评价
In socializing, presets the other party's negative views and stays silent

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Keeps pressuring themselves with stricter goals
在训练与关系中频繁Self-denial和比较，限制自我表达

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse he wants to make toward other people or things, and turns the energy originally intended to be sent outward toward himself, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向朋友寻求支持而选择加码训练来“对付”自己
Transforming the comfort and understanding that should be sought outward into internal self-blame

positive_force: Has some cycling training foundation and past achievements (can serve as evidence to remind myself)
Has self-observation and expression abilities, willing to try alternative viewpoints
Work表现not yet受直接影响，生活结构相对稳定
Has some friend resources; potential social support exists
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的思维倾向
Comparing oneself with others leads to self-deprecation
Overly setting strict goals, continuously pressuring oneself
not愿向朋友表达脆弱导致支持难以获得
Overgeneralizing one failure as overall failure

target_behavior.behavior: 训练前出现强烈Anxiety与“已被打败”的感受，训练中走神或中途without法完成
antecedent: 回想几个月前not yet达成的目标
Seeing others ride faster or perform better
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化认知与预测not yet来的负性期待，受自我标签“失败者”驱动
target_behavior.function: 逃避感知到的失败与评判，短期减轻Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 训练质量下降、without法完成计划，进一步ReinforcementSelf-doubt与失败信念

target_behavior.behavior: In training and goal setting, continually raises the bar, setting overly strict goals
antecedent: 一次失败或not yet达标后的Self-denial
target_behavior.core_reason: 试图通过自我苛责与更高标准来弥补“not够好”的核心信念
target_behavior.function: Gains a short-term sense of control and self-soothing (feels one is taking action)
target_behavior.consequence: Increased stress、体验恶化，动机进一步下降，Self-doubt worsens

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance：not向朋友谈及Self-doubt与训练困扰
antecedent: 想到与朋友交流时担心被评判为软弱或not够能力
Interacting with cycling partners or thinking of their views
target_behavior.core_reason: Tendencies toward mind reading and personalization of others' negative evaluations, fears exposure of vulnerability
target_behavior.function: 避免潜在的羞耻与被negate感
target_behavior.consequence: Social support hard to obtain、Interpersonal relationships受损，Loneliness感与Negative emotions persisting
